scale: 1x sources: draw at whole multiples (3x-4x on the TV, 2x-3x on phones) with nearest filtering
nineSlice: slice = [left, top, right, bottom] insets of the source rect. outset = how far the source reaches outside the element's box (studs, glows): draw the source at box.x - outset.left, box.y - outset.top, sized box + outset. padding = content inset inside the box. The centre and edges are flat, so tile or stretch both work; tile keeps pixels square.

tooltip_tail.attach: centred under the tooltip, its top row on the tooltip's bottom rim; flip it vertically to point up

dialogue_tab.attach: x = dialogue box left + 6, y = dialogue box top - 7 (it straddles the top edge)

banner.stretch: horizontal; keep the source height so the pointed ends stay sharp

banner_crest.attach: centred on the banner's top edge

turn_strip.header: the label sits in the top 8 px

compose: Draw the frame 9-slice at the bar's width (its height is fixed). frame.fill = [x, y, height]: the fill area starts at (x, y) and is (width - 2x) wide.
fillW = round(innerW * value / max), at least 3 when value > 0. Tile `mid` across fillW, then draw `left` at the start and `right` ending at fillW (the bright leading edge).
Damage ghost: when HP drops, keep the old width for ~0.4 s, then shrink it to the new one. Draw it first: tile `ghost_mid` across ghostW and end with `ghost_right`; the real fill goes on top.
ct tiles in 4 px segments, so snap its fillW to a multiple of 4 for whole notches.
Damage ghost drain (anims.ghost_drain): after the hit, hold the ghost 0.3 s, then over the strip's 5 frames tile frame f as the ghost and ease its width to the new value.
Heal sweep (anims.heal_sweep): grow the fill to the new value over 0.3 s; meanwhile play the sweep additively across the healed span (scale its travel to that span, clip it to the fill).

markers.projection: a 32 px tile projected 2:1 (x = U - V, y = (U + V) / 2). Put frame pixel (32, 16) on the tile top's centre. A pixel belongs to a tile when its centre falls inside it, so markers and path pieces on neighbouring tiles meet exactly.

path.naming: straight_<a>_<b> and corner_<a>_<b> join the two edges; start_<d> sits on the unit's tile and leaves through <d>; end_<d> is entered through <d> and points the other way.

arrow.place: anchor ~6 px above the unit's head, or 20 px above an empty tile's centre

now_tab.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = frame box top - 7

ai_badge.attach: right edge 2 px past the frame box's right, y = box top - 6

stripe_p1.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

stripe_p2.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

stripe_p3.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

stripe_p4.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

stripe_p5.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

stripe_p6.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

stripe_enemy.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

stripe_neutral.attach: x = frame box left + 2, y = box bottom + 1, width = box width - 4

numbers.note: Each rect includes a 1 px rim and a 1 px drop shadow (right and below). Pen x advances by `advance`; neighbouring glyphs' rims touch but their fills keep 2 px apart.

tooltip_header.headerNote: the header text sits in rows header[0]..header[0]+header[1] of the box; body below

toast_info.enter: slide in from the right edge over 0.2 s, hold ~3 s, fade 0.3 s

toast_success.enter: slide in from the right edge over 0.2 s, hold ~3 s, fade 0.3 s

toast_warning.enter: slide in from the right edge over 0.2 s, hold ~3 s, fade 0.3 s

toast_danger.enter: slide in from the right edge over 0.2 s, hold ~3 s, fade 0.3 s

objective.title: the first 8 px of the box is the title row (OBJECTIVE / round counter)

reaction.ring: the countdown ring sits in the left padding, vertically centred

minimap.window: the box minus 3 px all round is transparent: draw the map first, then the frame
minimap.compass: draw minimap_compass centred on the box's top edge, its tick pointing in

minimap_compass.attach: centre x on the minimap box, y = box top - 6

glint_h.use: slide along a gold edge, centre on the edge's middle row, every few seconds

glint_v.use: slide along a gold edge, centre on the edge's middle row, every few seconds

panel_shimmer.note: frames of the 'main' panel source with the same slice: swap it in for the main panel while it plays

countdown_ring.note: frame = round(16 * elapsed / limit); the last frame is the empty ring

ghost_drain.note: tile frame f as the ghost fill while its width eases to the new value

glyphs.note: Gamepad (Xbox letters and colours, PlayStation shapes), keyboard and mouse prompts at 1x. key_blank is a 9-slice cap for any legend the game sets itself. Show glyphs at the UI scale beside the action's name, e.g. [A] Confirm  [B] Back  [LB][RB] Cycle.
